item.title: PILLANI Recalls Nursing Pillows Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Suffocation; Violate Mandatory Standards for Nursing Pillows
item.company: Sold Online At: Amazon.com from April 2026 through September 2026 for between $30 and $40.
item.brand: Sold Online At: Amazon.com from April 2026 through September 2026 for between $30 and $40.
item.summary: This recall involves PILLANI-branded nursing pillows. The U-shaped nursing pillows were sold in the following colors and prints: cloud and stars, wild animal, white with leaf and feather, stars, pink with leaf, light blue, pink, light yellow, gray, light gray, beige and light green. The pillows have a smaller pillow attached atop and an adjustable waist strap. The brand name, model number NP4351 and batch numbers 202604, 202605 or 202606 are printed on an attached label.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: PILLANI Nursing Pillows.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the nursing pillows immediately and contact PILLANI for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to send a photo of the product and be provided with disposal instructions. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
